title: Carefree Days | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home exudes sophistication and comfort with an open concept space on the first floor that's perfect for hosting group meals or engaging in lively entertainment. The chef’s kitchen, boasting gleaming stainless steel appliances, pairs seamlessly with the elegant dining area, setting the stage for memorable dinners and social gatherings. Ample windows invite the Florida sunshine to dance across the pristine interiors, while the backsliders open to a covered patio — ideal for alfresco dining or evening cocktails as stars begin to pepper the sky. The built-in grill adds a touch of indulgence to home-cooked meals, beckoning guests to savor flavors only steps away from a refreshing dip in the pool. As the sun sets, retreat to one of the four plush bedrooms, including two master suites that promise a luxurious respite. The ground floor master is a sanctuary with its king bed, flat-screen TV, and en suite bath featuring dual sinks, a walk-in tile shower, and a separate soaker tub. The second-floor mirrors in opulence, accompanied by an additional living room that offers a private haven for children or guests. Drift off to sleep in comfort and style, enveloped in neutral tones and high-quality bedding. This Destin haven invites you to live lavishly and unwind thoroughly, with both the space and elegance to forge unforgettable moments just minutes from the tranquil Gulf shoreline.
